body:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Arjun Desai <arjun.desai@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Nov 5, 2024 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Launch approval: Optimize Quantization Profile Library (Beta) — go/no-go + escalation owners

Hi all — requesting go/no-go approval to open the Quantization Profile Library (opt-in) beta this week.

We’re ready on feature completeness; remaining question is whether we’re comfortable with the guardrails + operational posture for first customer traffic.

Proposed beta scope
- Opt-in via route-level setting (Console + API), with canary percentage.
- Redwood-published profiles only (no customer uploads).
- Initial models/hardware: limited to the profiles that passed acceptance thresholds and are signed + validated in registry.
- Beta cohort: small set of Design Partners + internal dogfood routes.

Go/No-Go checklist (must be “GREEN”)
1) Quality gates
   - Baseline vs quantized deltas within acceptance thresholds on the quant prompt sets.
   - Tool-calling / JSON-mode regression check: no increase in invalid JSON rate above threshold.
   - Approval recorded (Applied ML sponsor + Evals/perf lead).
2) Perf/cost
   - Measured unit cost reduction meets minimum threshold on representative load shapes.
   - No p95 latency regression above threshold for the supported seq-length bins.
3) Safety / rollout controls
   - Route-level enablement works with canary %.
   - Auto-disable signal path validated end-to-end (simulated regression -> disable -> fallback to baseline).
   - Fallback on incompatibility (GPU arch / kernel mismatch) verified.
4) Observability + billing attribution
   - Traces/metrics tag quantized vs baseline, and profile id/version.
   - Cost attribution correct at token level and reflected in dashboards.
5) Security/compliance
   - Profile artifact signing + verification enabled in runtime.
   - Audit log entries on enable/disable/config changes.
6) Docs + support readiness
   - Beta docs published (terminology locked: “quantization profile”).
   - Internal support playbook + escalation owners documented.

Success metrics for beta (2–3 weeks)
- >= 20% unit cost reduction on at least one real customer route (measured tokens/$) without exceeding quality thresholds.
- < 2% of quantized requests triggering fallback due to incompatibility.
- Zero Sev-1 incidents attributable to quantization enablement.
- < 0.5% increase in invalid JSON/tool-calling errors on opted-in routes.
- Adoption: >= 3 customers enabling on at least one non-interactive workload route (batch summarization, background jobs).

Escalation / on-point owners (proposed)
- Profile quality/regression questions: Arjun (primary), Maya (approval)
- Runtime compatibility/perf regressions: Mateo (primary)
- Rollout/auto-disable + operational response: Sean (primary)
- Telemetry/cost attribution: Logan (primary)
- Security/audit signing issues: Marcus (primary)
- Docs + customer comms: Elliot (primary)

If no objections, I’d like to send a “GO” email by EOD Wed and schedule the beta enablement window Thurs morning.

Attaching checklist + runbook drafts.

Thanks,
Aditya
Product Lead, Optimize
Redwood Inference

— Attachments —
1) Quantization Profiles Beta — Go-NoGo Checklist v3 (PDF)
2) Quant Profiles Beta — Success Metrics & Guardrails (Google Doc link)
3) Quantization Profile Rollback Runbook — draft v1.2 (PDF)


From: Dr. Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Arjun Desai <arjun.desai@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Nov 5, 2024 at 10:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: Launch approval: Optimize Quantization Profile Library (Beta) — go/no-go + escalation owners

Thanks. From Applied ML side, I’m comfortable with a beta with the following conditions:

- We only publish the subset of profiles that are “GREEN” on the tool-calling/JSON prompt set (not “yellow”).
- For the first week, cap canary at 10% max unless we explicitly approve a per-route increase.
- Any increase in invalid JSON rate over baseline beyond the stated threshold should auto-disable on that route (no manual gate).

Arjun/Jonas — please reply with current status per initial profile list and whether any are still pending the JSON-mode gate.

Maya


From: Arjun Desai <arjun.desai@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Selene Huang <selene.huang@redwoodinference.com>, Priyanka Bose <priyanka.bose@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Nov 5, 2024 at 11:26 AM PT
Subject: Re: Launch approval: Optimize Quantization Profile Library (Beta) — go/no-go + escalation owners

Status summary (as of this morning):

GREEN (quality + perf):
- int8 profile for the initial supported model set: passes JSON-mode invalid rate threshold and tool-calling set.
- int4 profile: passes on general + long-context, but NOT approved for JSON-mode routes (we saw a small but repeatable bump in schema violations).

Recommendation:
- Beta launch with int8 only as default recommended profile.
- int4 remains available but only for explicitly marked “non-JSON” routes + requires Maya approval for any customer enablement.

Also confirming we have the approval workflow captured in the profile publish PR template (Maya + Jonas sign-off) and attached gating artifacts.

Arjun


From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Nov 5, 2024 at 2:14 PM PT
Subject: Re: Launch approval: Optimize Quantization Profile Library (Beta) — go/no-go + escalation owners

Runtime side: OK to proceed with beta given the canary cap.

Notes:
- Profile resolution caching is stable post-hotfix (we added backoff to avoid stampede on refresh).
- Incompatibility fallback is working (we explicitly log + tag metrics when we drop to baseline).
- Remaining sharp edge: GPU SKU mismatch when customers have mixed pools in Dedicated. We have guardrails but want to keep cohort small and require validation on Dedicated before expanding.

Request: For beta cohort selection, can we prefer Hosted traffic first + 1 Dedicated design partner where we control GPU matrix?

Mateo


From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Nov 6, 2024 at 8:41 AM PT
Subject: Re: Launch approval: Optimize Quantization Profile Library (Beta) — go/no-go + escalation owners

SRE: conditionally GO.

Blocking items before we flip any customer route:
1) Confirm the auto-disable action is scoped per-route (not org-wide) and has an audit log entry with actor = “system”.
2) Add an alert for: invalid JSON rate delta + 5xx delta segmented by (route_id, profile_id).
3) Run the rollback runbook once in staging with Connor watching, including cache flush/invalidation.

If we can complete those today, we’re good for a Thurs morning enablement window.

Sean


From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Nov 6, 2024 at 1:19 PM PT
Subject: Re: Launch approval: Optimize Quantization Profile Library (Beta) — go/no-go + escalation owners

Security review status: GO for beta with the current constraints.

- Artifact signing/verifying: enabled for the quant profile manifest + referenced blobs.
- Publish permissions: still restricted (Applied ML group only, via the internal request trail).
- Audit logging: requirement is met for enable/disable + canary changes.

One request: in the customer-facing docs, please explicitly state that profiles are Redwood-published only and that changes are auditable + reversible per route.

Marcus


From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Arjun Desai <arjun.desai@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Nov 7, 2024 at 4:38 PM PT
Subject: Re: Launch approval: Optimize Quantization Profile Library (Beta) — go/no-go + escalation owners

Update + decision request:

Completed today (GREEN):
- Staging rollback runbook executed end-to-end (route disable -> baseline -> cache invalidation). Connor confirmed.
- Auto-disable verified to be per-route and produces audit entry (actor: system).
- Alerts created: invalid JSON delta + 5xx delta segmented by route_id/profile_id.
- Docs updated to clarify “Redwood-published profiles only” + route-scoped reversibility (Elliot incorporated Marcus’s note).

Scope confirmed for beta:
- int8 profiles only for customer enablement in week 1.
- Canary cap: 10% for first week (can raise per-route with explicit approval).
- Hosted-first cohort, then 1 Dedicated design partner after validation.

Escalation owners (final):
- Quality/regression: Arjun (primary), Maya (approval)
- Runtime/perf/compat: Mateo
- SRE/rollback/auto-disable: Sean
- Telemetry/cost attribution: Logan
- Security/audit/signing: Marcus
- Docs/support comms: Elliot

If you’re both comfortable: please reply “GO” and we’ll schedule Thurs next week (11/14) 10:00–12:00 PT as the beta enablement window, with SRE + runtime + applied ML in the channel.

Aditya
